Yoga for Sciatica Pain Relief | 11 Stretches to Ease Nerve Pain in Back & Legs
Are you experiencing radiating pain from your glutes down your thighs, calves, or even your foot? You may be dealing with a pinched sciatic nerve—often caused by a disc bulge or spinal compression. This type of nerve pain, known as sciatica, can worsen with long hours of sitting or standing.
In this guided yoga session, you’ll learn 11 gentle and effective yoga poses designed to:
Decompress your lower spine
